children: looks neutral in a range of $4,136-$4,178 per ounce, and an escape could suggest a direction.
A break above $4,178 may lead to a gain into $4,194-$4,220 range. However, the bias might be toward the downside, as the market is approaching $4,136.
A break may trigger a fall into $4,085-$4,111 range. Trending signals turned neutral and will become clear when the market escapes from a wider range of $4,111-$4,220.
On the daily chart, the metal returned to the $4,122-$4,233 range after briefly falling below it. This range slightly overlaps with the $4,111-$4,220 range on the hourly chart.
Based on the big black candle on September 28 and the break below $4,233, the 61.8% retracement level, the market may resume its downtrend.
